notes.title: 605 -to- 621 : Dan_Zoom , Zio_Blend , Muffin_Puncher
notes.notes:
Mr. Muffin Man Dan wanted some zoom filters , so I made them for him .
Because Dan asked for them , they have been named in Dan's Honor .
You are welcome @#532 : M_uffin Daniel !

The display names for these new filters look ugly as sin . 
And I should fix them . I'll do that in the next update !

Filters 605 -to- 621 are all Dan inspired .

3 Categories of Dan Inspired Filters :

1. DANZOOM(s)
2. ZIOBLEND(s)
3. Muffin Punchers

-KanjiCoder

notes.title: Voltie found a bug in their video review , voltie gets a personalized copy !
notes.notes:
In this video voltie can be seen using filter 42 and the
previous image is coming through . This happens if you
use the TILE BRUSH , then use "R" to reset , and then
use filter 42 on the entire image using the enter key .

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=GlLsYDMTuKc

The issue has been fixed and in the sourcecode you can find
the fix by searching for[ _BUGFIX_VOLTIE_ ] .

-KanjiCoder
